notes: CardDemo job TRANREPT (app/proc/TRANREPT.prc): STEP05R (the DFSORT step, lowered to COBOL SORT by det/dfsort.py) then STEP10R (CBTRN03C). STEP10R's TRANFILE is STEP05R's SORTOUT, the COBOL side's bytes, also given to the Java side. STEP10R reads the same date window STEP05R sorts on (2022-01-01 .. 2022-07-06, the job's one parameter card: its own case's 2022-07-01 .. 07-31 window would leave this feed with an empty report). Each step is proven as its own batch case; the chain is their composition. Assumption: the JCL wiring is this file, not a read job (register F4).
